## Test quality

Apply the adopted testing strategy when reviewing tests or harnesses. Verify the
observable contract, credible regression, existing proof, distinct risk and chosen
boundary against the actual path. Reject assertion-free probes, self-comparisons,
copied implementation expectations, unjustified duplicate coverage, and mocks or
fixtures that manufacture the asserted receipt, admission, acknowledgement,
ordering or persisted outcome. Check that negative controls reach the intended
guard and that names match exercised behavior. A declaration of a capability is
not proof of delivery. Identify the concrete escaped regression in a finding.

Preserve critical-flow browser outcomes and targeted database authorization,
isolation, transaction, replay and race proof. Static packaging/permissions checks,
snapshots and protocol ordering can protect real contracts: judge the failure
detected, not syntax. For deletion inspect retained stronger proof; for fixes check
fail-before/pass-after evidence or the stated gap. Verify registration, actual
execution and unexpected skips. The five PR rationale fields are a minimum,
not automatic approval. Apply the existing review severity/disposition policy;
do not demand duplicate tests or ceremonial test counts.
